mechanism_narrative: The level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is a leading indicator of labor market strength. Higher PAYEMS values correlate with stronger corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is below 140000, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions that accelerate inflation expectations, triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.5%, 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 240 and FEDFUNDS above 0.5% indicates accelerating inflation and monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 240 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market (HOUST > 1200) and elevated consumer spending (RSAFS > 450000) indicate robust demand conditions that support corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is a leading indicator of economic activity. Higher INDPRO values correlate with stronger economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 103.0, 5d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 signal strong housing market demand, supporting related sectors and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200, 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 103.5) and housing starts (HOUST > 1200) indicates synchronized economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 103.5 and HOUST > 1200, 5d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, 60d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
